base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT p.XCL_123
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122
WHERE pa.XCL_133 = (SELECT MAX(XCL_133) FROM Player_Attributes)
LIMIT 1;
